summary: To write Windows paths in TOML, use forward slashes or a single-quoted literal string.
When a Windows path in Python source raises a unicode escape error, write it with forward slashes or as a raw string.
A change to an agent's launch config does not reach agent processes that were already running before the change.
A shell pipeline's exit status is that of its last command, so "cmd | tail" hides a failure of cmd unless pipefail is set.
To confirm that a config change took effect, check each running process's command line or log rows, not the config file.
Python's open() in text mode on Windows turns each "\n" written into "\r\n" unless the newline argument is set.
To keep line endings unchanged when a Python script rewrites files on Windows, open them with newline="" or newline="\n".
To see failures of piped commands in bash, run set -o pipefail first, or check the command's exit code before trimming its output.
In a normal Python string, \U starts an 8-hex-digit escape, so a Windows path containing \Users raises a SyntaxError.
Before Python 3.15, Python on Windows encodes redirected stdout in the ANSI code page (such as cp950), not UTF-8.
To print non-ASCII text from Python through a pipe on Windows, run it with -X utf8, which also works under -I.
Python's -I (isolated mode) makes the interpreter ignore all PYTHON* environment variables, including PYTHONIOENCODING.
Windows PowerShell 5.1 cannot parse the && and || chain operators, which first appeared in PowerShell 7.0.
In a TOML basic string, a backslash starts an escape, so a Windows path written with backslashes is usually invalid TOML.
In agent-library, entries must not contain private paths, private network addresses or secrets.
To trust a delegate's "not found" verdict, run it with the target project as its working directory or check the path yourself first.
To coordinate concurrent heavy test runs on a shared machine, allow one at a time machine-wide and check commit headroom before starting, not only a per-agent quota.
A long-running background job can stall for hours while all its processes stay alive, so a watcher that waits only for exit notices never sees it.
To catch a stalled long job, watch the age of its last progress mark (log line, checkpoint, heartbeat file) rather than whether its process is alive.
A read-only delegate sandboxed to its working directory can report code as missing when that code lives outside the directory, even if given its absolute path.
Per-agent test-parallelism limits do not bound a shared machine: concurrent parallel test runs, each within its own limit, can together drain commit headroom and pause another job.
A coding delegate can report a passing test suite while none of the test cases it was asked to add were written.
To trust a coding delegate's "tests pass" report, require it to list the names of the new tests it added, then check that each requested case is among them.
